# V2 synthetic test fixtures

All JSON files in this directory are **synthetic E2E inputs**, not verified facts about the ForkRight repository or any actual security incident. `FRSA-2026-001`, releases, responses, inactivity periods and restoration actions are fictional scenarios for testing contract state transitions. The manifest binds the two designated test wallets to the `v2-e2e-001` test covenant only. Do not cite these fixtures as evidence of real GitHub history or use the resulting succession state for repository governance.
